Job Description
Multi-Mission Helicopter Sensor Operators detect, analyze, classify, track, and engage sub-surface, surface, and air contacts: perform Sound Navigation
and Ranging (SONAR), sonobuoy, Radio Detection and Ranging (RADAR), Intelligence Surveillance Reconnaissance and Targeting (ISR-T), Electronic
Warfare (EW), Electro-Optical and Infrared (EO/IR), Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR) and LINK-16 operations; coordinate tactical
communications relay; conduct weapons delivery in support of tactical missions; conduct Command and Control (C2); execute Long Range Maritime
Strike (MARSTK) missions, support Special Operations Forces (SOF) missions, Search and Rescue (SAR) missions, Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster
Relief (HADR) missions, Night Vision Device (NVD) operations, navigation, passenger and cargo transports, Vertical Replenishment (VERTREP)
operations, Medical Evacuations (MEDEVAC), Helicopter Visit Board Search and Seizure (HVBSS) operations, and Crew-Served Weapons (CSW)
employment; perform Basic Life Support (BLS) and Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TCCC); perform observer duties and Crew Resource Management
(CRM) for safety of flight; and contribute directly to aircrew operations, training and administration.

Naval Aircrewmen (Tactical Helicopter) (AWR) detect, analyze, classify, track, and engage sub-surface, surface, and air contacts; perform Sound Navigation and Ranging (SONAR), sonobuoy, Radio Detection and Ranging (RADAR), Intelligence Surveillance Reconnaissance and Targeting (ISR-T), Electronic Warfare (EW), Electro-Optical (EO)/Infrared (IR), Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR) and LINK-16 operations; coordinate tactical communications relay; conduct weapons delivery in support of tactical missions; conduct Command and Control (C2); execute Long Range Maritime Strike (MARSTK) missions; support Special Operations Forces (SOF) missions, Search and Rescue (SAR) missions, Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) missions, Night Vision Device (NVD) operations, navigation, passenger and cargo transports, Vertical Replenishment (VERTREP) operations, Medical Evacuations (MEDEVAC), Helicopter Visit Board Search and Seizure (HVBSS) operations, and Crew-Served Weapons (CSW) employment; perform observer duties and Crew Resource Management (CRM) for safety of flight; and contribute directly to aircrew operations, training, and administration. __________________________________________

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
